name: airbrake_delete
title: Delete an Airbrake error group or source map
description: Permanently delete an Airbrake resource. resource "group" requires group_id (deletes the error group and its notices); resource "sourcemap" requires sourcemap_id. Pass only the ID for the chosen resource — omit the other one (it is rejected, not ignored). IDs MUST be passed as strings (19-digit snowflakes). Irreversible. Disabled when AIRBRAKE_READ_ONLY is set. Returns the raw Airbrake JSON payload (usually null for 204).

group_id.description: Required when resource is "group"; omit otherwise

sourcemap_id.description: Required when resource is "sourcemap"; omit otherwise

annotations.title: Delete an Airbrake error group or source map
